scenes.text: Did you know the world is running out of sand?
To build skyscrapers, glass, and microchips, we need jagged, angular sand found only in rivers and lakes.
This has created a massive black market, with sand mafias illegally dredging rivers, destroying ecosystems, and even stealing entire beaches overnight.
Saudi Arabia actually imports sand from Australia to build its massive mega-projects because their own desert sand won't work.
